name: snare-vine

canvasPlacement.registration: All cels use one common scale and horizontal anchor. Per-cel vertical translation registers the drawn foot/belly ground contact; there is no per-cel fitting or scaling.

method: Directly drawn anatomical death cels from the accepted reference. Shared uniform scale, fixed horizontal registration and registered ground contact; all body, limb, leaf and tendril silhouettes are redrawn through collapse. The earlier continuous rig is preserved as editable reference but is not used by this drawn sequence.
rootMotion: Drawn body collapse; settled belly/head retains the common ground contact.
previewLoop: The preview repeats for inspection; runtime death is non-looping and holds the settled pose.
